description: Keep a repository's README for the person deciding whether and how to use it, its AGENTS.md (or a CLAUDE.md read through it) for the agent working inside it, and the manifests hosts read first (package.json, plugin and marketplace files, agents/openai.yaml) on the repository's one name: audit them with the bundled script, then move each line to the file whose reader needs it and fix each disagreeing manifest. Use when writing, rewriting or reviewing a README or an AGENTS.md, when an agent-only command shows up in a README or marketing copy in an agent guide, when deciding which file a section belongs in, or after a rename. Not for contracts, ledgers, changelogs or release notes.
